facts.fact: Jody 打电话改计划：Ashton 偏头痛需要帮忙，Ev 与 Ruth 已先走，轮到 Brooks。
facts.anchor: Ashton is out on the ranch somewhere with a migraine and needs help. He and Ev leapt into Ev’s truck, with Ruth in the back, and now it’s my turn.

facts.fact: 他开灯看见床上摊开的半装箱子——轮子刻意朝外悬在床沿。
facts.anchor: I flick on her bedroom light to find a half-packed suitcase lying open on her bed, wheels carefully positioned to hang off the side.

facts.fact: 他不想她走，却还是拉上箱链、推到角落，然后去浴室。
facts.anchor: I zip the suitcase, careful not to disturb anything inside it, and wheel it to the corner of the room. Then I head for the bathroom.

facts.fact: 浴室柜里找到药，还看到镜后并排的纸杯蛋糕味唇膏。
facts.anchor: Everett found her medicine in the cabinet, so I stop there next, smiling when I see several lined-up tubes of that cupcake lip balm behind the mirrored door.

facts.fact: 他抱来新床单换上，又拿干净杯子装满水。
facts.anchor: I grab a fresh set of bed sheets from the cupboard in the hallway and change them, then grab a clean glass from the kitchen and fill it with water.

facts.fact: 从 Ev 口中得知：偏头痛时陪她说话的是 Jody 的哥哥 Reston。
facts.anchor: And yet, Reston was the one who was talking to her when a migraine hit and she needed help.

facts.fact: 他向 Ev 汇报：换了新床单、药放床头柜、浴室铺毛巾。
facts.anchor: I put fresh sheets on her bed, left her meds on her night stand. I laid some towels down in case she gotta get friendly with the bathroom floor.

facts.fact: 他去马厩看 Mayo——她的 soul horse，Jody 跟它没那么熟。
facts.anchor: Mayo is a special one—he’s Ashton’s soul horse—and he doesn’t know Jody nearly as well as he knows me and Ev.

relations: Ashton 是他最好的朋友（As much my best friend as her brother is）
Ashton 是 Ev 的亲妹妹，Ev 是 Brooks 的最好朋友
她与 Reston 一直保持密切电话往来——Brooks 原不知道
